result.markdown:
# Traffic Drop in Sfax due to Fiber Link Transport Failure

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_failure at `LNK-SFX-01-A`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct site down alarms and recovery times on all three sites sharing LNK-SFX-01-A; changes and maintenance ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-16 14:00 to 2026-09-16 16:47
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-16 14:08
- **Affected:** S-SFX-002, S-SFX-006, S-SFX-009, LNK-SFX-01-A

## Summary

Simultaneous critical site down alarms on three sites sharing fiber link LNK-SFX-01-A.

Traffic, active users, and availability dropped on three sites in Sfax from 14:00 to 16:47.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-16 14:00: Traffic and availability drop begins on three sites in Sfax. [T1, T7]
- 2026-09-16 14:08: Critical SITE_DOWN alarm raised on S-SFX-002. [T9, ALM-000318]
- 2026-09-16 14:08: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-SFX-009 and S-SFX-006. [T9, ALM-000319, ALM-000320]
- 2026-09-16 16:45: SITE_DOWN alarm cleared on S-SFX-009. [T9, ALM-000319]
- 2026-09-16 16:46: SITE_DOWN alarm cleared on S-SFX-002. [T9, ALM-000318]
- 2026-09-16 16:47: SITE_DOWN alarm cleared on S-SFX-006. [T9, ALM-000320]

## Evidence

- Three sites in SFX experienced simultaneous critical SITE_DOWN alarms starting at 14:08. [T9, ALM-000318, ALM-000319, ALM-000320]
- All affected sites share the same fiber link LNK-SFX-01-A as their lowest common parent. [T5]
- No configuration changes occurred on S-SFX-002, S-SFX-006, S-SFX-009 or their parents during the window. [T3, T10]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected sites and their parents. [T4]
- No external events were recorded for region SFX between 12:00 and 18:00. [T6]

## Inferences

- The simultaneous recovery of all three sites around 16:45 points to an upstream transport recovery. [T9]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_failure** at LNK-SFX-01-A: confirmed. Simultaneous site drops and recoveries on nodes sharing LNK-SFX-01-A without local configuration changes indicate a shared transport issue. [T2, T5, T9]
2. **bad_change**: rejected. No changes were executed on the affected sites or their ancestor nodes during the window. [T3, T10]
3. **planned_maintenance**: rejected. No maintenance windows were scheduled for the affected sites or their parents. [T4]

## Ruled out

- T3: No changes were found on the sites or their parents.
- T4: No maintenance windows were scheduled.
- T6: No external events were reported for the region.
- T10: No configuration changes were found on AGG-SFX-01 and its parents.
- T11: No direct alarms were raised on LNK-SFX-01-A and AGG-SFX-01 themselves.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect transport link LNK-SFX-01-A for fiber performance or intermittent breaks.
- Verify transceiver health and optical power levels on LNK-SFX-01-A endpoints.

truth.notes: trap=missing_alarm; Fibre cut on LNK-SFX-01-A; all 3 downstream sites lost service until repair. The LINK_LOS alarm was never raised: only SITE_DOWN alarms on the sites exist. Trap: there is no alarm on LNK-SFX-01-A, only 3 SITE_DOWN alarms on sites, so a hasty investigator names a site or a set of independent site faults. Settled by: get_topology shows that the 3 sites share the parent LNK-SFX-01-A and that nothing else hangs under it; they went down in the same minute and sites on sibling links stayed up, so the shared link is the one cause.
